rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who tends a bar and serves drinks.

example.english: The bartender at that bar is very good at looking after customers.
example.traditional: 嗰間酒吧嘅酒保好識招呼客人。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zau2 baa1 ge3 zau2 bou2 hou2 sik1 ziu1 fu1 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a bartender's professional skill in mixing cocktails and other drinks.

example.english: This bartender really knows how to mix cocktails.
example.traditional: 呢位調酒師好識調雞尾酒。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 tiu4 zau2 si1 hou2 sik1 tiu4 gai1 mei5 zau2
